The context passages repeatedly mention that Oliver Brown sued the Topeka Board of Education regarding his daughter Linda's schooling. Specifically, documents state she was forced to attend a "segregated" or "all-black" school if she chose to attend school in the segregated system, and had to walk a long distance to it. The core of the lawsuit was challenging the constitutionality of this arrangement.

The question asks "over which school his daughter might attend". The distinguishing feature of the school in the lawsuit was that it was the designated **segregated** (or separate) school.

<answer>segregated school</answer>
